Village House in Rio de Mel - Investment Opportunity

Complete documentation for financing!

We present this house in need of works located in Rio de Mel, in the quiet parish of São Gião. It is a village house with great potential, ideal for those looking for a refuge away from the urban hustle and bustle, in a peaceful environment surrounded by nature.

The property is spread over 2 main floors. The ground floor houses an antique kitchen with a traditional fireplace and 4 rooms, while the large attic provides versatile additional space. The basement has 2 covered outbuildings, perfect for storage or other purposes.

It has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, complemented by a terrace and balcony that allow you to enjoy the unobstructed views of the surrounding nature.

The villa is partially refurbished, requiring interior works to be completely habitable, which represents an excellent opportunity to customise the space according to preferences.

This is a perfect proposal for investors or for those who want to create their dream home in an authentic and welcoming rural setting.
